answer: Audits are logged in comet, queued in crystal, and river publishes the wait time. A farm of 118 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 38 identities per epoch. A farm of 4724 identities would post 2301 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
